description: This file defines types, interfaces, and functions related to inter-process communication (IPC) in the Playwright testing framework, including configuration serialization, test payloads, and process initialization.

methods.name: serializeConfig
methods.description: Serializes the full configuration object into a format suitable for IPC, optionally including the compilation cache.

methods.name: stdioChunkToParams
methods.description: Converts a chunk of data (string or Uint8Array) into a TestOutputPayload, encoding buffers as base64.
